name: Tsira Obumseli-Magnúsdóttir
location: The Narrows, Blackpipe Corridor, near Damen and Armitage
description:
Tsira is a rail-thin nine-year-old with close-cropped hair dyed the faded orange of someone who found a half-spent pigment cartridge and made the most of it. Her skin is deep brown, her eyes wide-set and alert, always tracking exits. She moves through Blackpipe Corridor like water through pipe joints — fast, quiet, and always finding the crack that leads somewhere else. She wears an oversized salvage-canvas vest with too many pockets, each one holding something she might need or trade.

She has been running messages for the pipe-stall vendors of Blackpipe for two years, since she was old enough to memorize a route without writing it down. She doesn't fully understand most of what she carries — folded slips of laminate, tiny beaded data-threads, once a tooth — but she understands that delivering on time means eating, and late means the cold corner by the effluent drain. She is cheerful with the intensity of someone who has decided cheerfulness is a survival tool.

core_fears: losing the alcove — her only stable ground
core_desires: enough food that she stops counting bites
someone who notices she is smart
coping_mechanisms: hypervigilant route-planning so she always knows the way out
blind_spots: trusts repeat customers too quickly once they've paid on time twice
psychology.secret: She has memorized the contents of three messages she was told were blank. She doesn't know what to do with what she knows but she keeps it, like a coin she found.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Street-clipped, inventive slang, mispronounces technical words confidently
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast and bouncing, sentences often trail into a question even when they aren't one
example_lines: Yeah-no I know where Vessel-court is, I been there before you were awake.
You want fast or you want safe? Can't always be both, cost you extra for both.

story_hooks: One of the messages she memorized contains coordinates she doesn't understand — someone has noticed she knows
She's been asked to carry something by a new client and the weight is wrong for what they said it was
narrative_function: Local color and unexpected information courier; knows the physical layout of Blackpipe better than anyone; can be a quest hook when she accidentally carries something dangerous; embodies the texture of Tier 1 child survival without being purely tragic
augmentations: None. Wants cat ears someday, has strong opinions about which color.
daily_life: Up before the district lights cycle on, runs four to seven message routes through Blackpipe and into the lower Narrows, spends afternoons haunting the stall of Auntie-vendor Pelé who sometimes feeds her in exchange for sweeping, sleeps in a dry maintenance alcove she shares with two older kids.
affiliation: Informal network of Blackpipe Corridor market vendors

decision_rules: If a client has paid on time twice, extend credit of trust
Never enter a space with only one exit unless the pay is very good
escalation_ladder: Tries to talk her way through — jokes, distracts, claims she's lost
Drops the package and runs if talking fails
Screams the vendor-network alarm phrase if cornered

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Friendly face, watching hands and feet, ready to bolt
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loud, generous with small things, will give you her last dry biscuit without being asked

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet and very still for ten seconds then explodes into motion
stress_responses.high: Runs first, processes second, cries later when alone

contradictions: Presents as carefree but has a mental ledger of every debt, favor, and slight going back two years
habits: Names the E.L.F.s in every device she passes — has given them all names she uses consistently
breaking_points: Discovering a trusted repeat client used her as an unknowing drug mule

timeline.event: Age 7 — parents split apart, mother took work in Ferrogate Transit maintenance tunnels, contact became irregular
Age 7.5 — began sleeping in the alcove with older kid named Crow who taught her the route system
Age 8 — Crow aged out and moved on; Tsira inherited the routes
Age 9, present — running solo, known by name to eleven vendor stalls

related_entities: Ringo Corponation SlipThread MX-3 Urban Cable Micro-Mobility Rig
Arcturus Defense Solutions SentinelSkin VS-4 Embedded Structural Acoustic Surveillance Membrane

physical_description.build: Rail-thin and wiry with the compact muscularity of a child who moves constantly through urban terrain. Underfed but not starving — subsistence-level nutrition sustained by vendor scraps and occasional proper meals. Her frame is all angles: sharp elbows, visible ribs under loose clothing, knees that seem too large for her legs.
physical_description.hair_color: Faded orange — uneven pigment application from a salvaged or shared cartridge, darker roots showing where natural dark brown is growing back in
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, uneven, self-cut or cut by another child with blunt implements. Practical for moving through tight spaces without catching on anything.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, wide-set, with the perpetually alert quality of someone constantly mapping escape routes
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle warm undertones from her Icelandic heritage creating a complex, layered complexion
physical_description.complexion: Clean but weathered for her age — sun-darkened from outdoor route-running, hands calloused at fingertips and palms from climbing, a small scar on her left cheekbone from an undefined past incident. No cosmetic grooming; functional cleanliness only. Slight shadows under her eyes suggesting inconsistent sleep.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar on left cheekbone, roughly 2cm long, slightly puckered at one end
Rope-burn calluses on both palms and inner fingers, evidence of climbing and gripping practices
Faint bruise on right shin in various stages of healing — occupational hazard of parkour-style movement through industrial terrain
physical_description.visible_augmentations: None. Completely organic. Her only expressed desire is for future augmentation — specifically cat ear implants, for which she has strong personal color preferences but limited means.
physical_description.posture_movement: Constantly in motion or coiled to move. Even when standing still, her weight is balanced on the balls of her feet. She moves through space like she's reading it — head up, eyes tracking sight lines and obstacles, body angled to move laterally or upward at any moment. Her natural state is forward momentum; stillness reads as temporary.
physical_description.clothing_style: Oversized salvage-canvas vest in weathered gray-tan, clearly scavenged from adult-sized stock, worn open over a faded undershirt with mismatched sleeves. The vest is her identity and tool — every pocket filled with small items: message capsules, trade goods, food scraps, a stub of pencil, things she might barter or need. Cheap pull-on pants in industrial gray, patched at both knees with different fabric colors. Worn slip-on shoes with the heels stomped flat. No jewelry except a single rubber band holding her hair back. Her aesthetic is 100% function — every item chosen for utility or survival, nothing for aesthetics. Tier 5 by default, but her role gives her access to Tier 3-4 spaces where she operates invisibly.

image_prompt: A nine-year-old girl, rail-thin with deep brown skin and wide alert eyes, close-cropped faded orange hair with dark roots showing. She wears an oversized weathered gray salvage-canvas vest with too many pockets over a mismatched undershirt, cheap gray industrial pants patched at the knees, and stomped-heel shoes. She's in motion — balanced on the balls of her feet, angled forward, reading the space around her like water through pipes. Urban cyberpunk setting, gritty industrial corridor with visible pipe infrastructure and stall market backdrop. Cold fluorescent and neon lighting casting deep shadows. She has the focused intensity of a child for whom movement is survival. Shot from waist-up, dynamic pose suggesting constant readiness.
